_comment: Ratchet for bun run test:audit. Counts may only go down. Lower a number in the same commit that lowers the count.
_sourceShape: 80 -> 18 when the app's stylesheet tests stopped reading styles.css and hub.css as text and started installing the sheets and reading a computed value (packages/workspaces-app/test/css-harness.ts). Sixty-two read sites went with them, across forty-two files. The eighteen that remain are the MCP suite's reads of the built plugin bundle, the server suite's reads of a published client release, and three stylesheet reads in two files that happy-dom cannot express: decide-option-hover-css.test.ts, whose whole subject is a :hover treatment, and hub-nav-widget-clearance-css.test.ts, whose rule is a calc() of max() and env() that happy-dom discards whole.
